title: V10 nested evaluation — analysis plan (frozen before any outer-fold prediction exists)

data.dataset: liver_ct_lits_verified_v8 (1,745 slices; 2,449 liver patches from patches_v8.npz)
data.task: patch-level tumour vs tumour-free liver tissue (96 x 96)
data.unit_note: reconstructed scan-group units, not patients; patient-level generalisation cannot be established

design.inner: grouped 3-fold over the training units (seeded by fold)
design.calibration: Platt scaling on pooled inner out-of-fold scores
design.threshold: Youden J on calibrated inner out-of-fold probabilities
design.seed_policy: stochastic models: 5 outer seeds averaged within unit; inner selection with seed 0

primary_estimand: unweighted mean within-unit ROC-AUC over units with >= 10 patches of each class
secondary: pooled out-of-fold AUC of calibrated probabilities
accuracy, balanced accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, precision, F1, MCC, log loss, Brier, ECE at the inner-chosen threshold

feature_sets.imagenet_gap: secondary family (same comparisons, own Holm correction)
feature_sets.cnn_embedding: not used (V9 CNN trained on V9 training groups: leaks across units)

test: exact two-sided sign-flip test of the mean per-unit AUC difference; Holm over the 3 comparisons
attainable_p_note: with 7 qualifying units the smallest two-sided p is 2/128 = 0.0156; a confirmatory difference needs all 7 units to agree
equivalence: not tested: margin rule (max(0.02, 2 x control seed SD)) would need inner-fold pilot estimates; non-significance is never reported as equivalence
exploratory: everything else (classical zoo, ablations, late fusion, feature-fusion hybrid)
